title: Break and Continue
summary: Inside loops you can change the flow: break exits the loop immediately, and continue skips to the next iteration.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program

sections.content: Inside loops you can change the flow: break exits the loop immediately, and continue skips to the next iteration.
Break is for "found it, stop searching"; continue is for "skip this one item". Both save you from wrapping the rest of the loop body in extra ifs.
Key points: break exits ALL remaining iterations, continue only skips the current one.
